name: 剧情知识库
scenarios: 实时阅读与直接编辑游戏剧情原稿、章节分支和关联记录。

onboarding.title: 选择要绑定的卡牌游戏仓库
onboarding.description: 本桌面的所有内容便笺共用同一份游戏检出，实时读取并在各自范围内直接编辑。
steps: 直接问：「要从 GitHub 下载 CardGame，还是使用你电脑上已有的游戏目录？」收到回答后，用 extension.invoke 调用 game-project 的 bind。用户选择默认 GitHub 版本时，传入 input: {source: "https://github.com/kllilizxc/CardGame", noteId: 当前设置资料中的 noteId}；选择本机目录时，source 是该目录的绝对路径。受理表示正在尝试绑定；便笺会在绑定完成后自动打开内容。

en.title: Choose the card game repository
en.description: All content notes on this desktop read live from and edit their own part of the bound checkout.
steps: Ask directly whether to download CardGame from GitHub or use an existing local folder. After the answer, call game-project bind via extension.invoke. For the default GitHub version, pass input: {source: "https://github.com/kllilizxc/CardGame", noteId: the setup noteId}; for a local checkout, use its absolute path as source. Admission means the binding is being attempted. The notes load automatically when it finishes.
